recent.text: Brandon Staley said the Saints will go with the “hot hand” at the CB2 spot between Quincy Riley and Martin Emerson Jr. Riley will be the first guy out there, but they’ll expect to get Emerson on the field. Sounds like a similar approach to some of the early-season games.
